SELECT
    JSON_QUERY(
        '[' +
        STRING_AGG(
            CAST(
                '{"table":"' + TableName +
                '","partition":"' + PartitionName + '"}'
                AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
            ),
            ','
        ) +
        ']'
    ) AS APIBody
FROM dbo.PowerBIRefreshConfig
WHERE DatasetID = 'b8aa8fb0-bed3-4f28-ba20-8ca0d114d5e0'
  AND RunFlag = 1;

INSERT INTO dbo.audit_log (adf_run_id, table_id,status,stage,start_time)

UPDATE dbo.audit_log
SET
    status = 'FAILED',
    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    error_message = 'Gold notebook pipeline execution failed'
WHERE adf_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.adf_run_id}'
  AND table_id = @{item().table_id}
  AND stage = 'SILVER_TO_GOLD';

MERGE dbo.audit_log AS tgt
USING
(
    SELECT table_id
    FROM dbo.table_config
    WHERE is_active = 1
      AND stage = 'SILVER_TO_GOLD'
      AND table_type = '@{pipeline().parameters.table_type}'
) AS src
ON  tgt.adf_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.adf_run_id}'
AND tgt.table_id = src.table_id
AND tgt.stage = 'SILVER_TO_GOLD'

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        status = 'FAILED',
        end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        error_message = 'Failed to retrieve Fabric notebook list'

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT
    (
        adf_run_id,
        table_id,
        status,
        stage,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        error_message
    )
    VALUES
    (
        '@{pipeline().parameters.adf_run_id}',
        src.table_id,
        'FAILED',
        'SILVER_TO_GOLD',
        SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        'Failed to retrieve Fabric notebook list'
    );
